wifi.DESCRIPTION: Each WiFi client's end of its link. Not a device: a device whose file lists "wifi" in its HOST_INFO's CLOCKWORK_CHAOS_IMPLEMENTS sends this subtree with {device} as its own name, and may add leaves of its own under /wifi/{device}. Stem reports the other end, how strongly the access point hears each client.

mac.DESCRIPTION: The WiFi station's MAC address, as six colon-separated hex pairs.

ip.DESCRIPTION: The WiFi station's IPv4 address, in dotted-quad form; empty while it has none.

rssi.DESCRIPTION: How strongly the device hears the access point. 0 while it is not associated, which no real reading is.
